```{python}
#| include: false
#| label: Download data center datasets 
from zipfile import ZipFile
import requests
from io import BytesIO

zip_file_url = 'https://epoch.ai/data/data_centers/data_centers.zip'
r = requests.get(zip_file_url, stream=True)

z = ZipFile(BytesIO(r.content))
z.extractall(path="data/data_centers")


data_centers = pd.read_csv("data/data_centers/data_centers.csv")

data_center_chillers = pd.read_csv("data/data_centers/data_center_chillers.csv")



```

# Altair demo

```{python}
# load a sample dataset as a pandas DataFrame
cars = data.cars()

# make the chart
alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x='Horsepower',
    y='Miles_per_Gallon',
    color='Origin',
).interactive()
```

# Exploratory Vis 1

```{python}

chart1 = alt.Chart(data_centers, title = "Data Center Cost vs Energy Use") \
    .mark_circle() \
    .encode(
    x=alt.X('Current total capital cost (2025 USD billions):Q', title = 'Current total capital cost (2025 USD billions)'),
    y=alt.Y('Current power (MW):Q', title = 'Current power (MW)'),
    color=alt.Color('Owner:N',legend = None),                   
    #size = alt.Size('avg_wage:Q', title='Average Wage (euros)'),

    # Hoverable information
    tooltip=[alt.Tooltip('Current total capital cost (2025 USD billions):Q'),
             alt.Tooltip('Current power (MW):Q'),
             alt.Tooltip('Owner:N')]

).properties(
    width = 800,
    height = 400
)

chart1.show()

```

```{python}
# Extract the state from data center address
data_centers['state'] = data_centers['Address'].str.extract(r',\s*([A-Z]{2})\s*\d{5}')

chart2 = alt.Chart(data_centers[data_centers['state'].notna()]).mark_bar(stroke='white', strokeWidth=1).encode(
    x=alt.X('state:N', title='State'),
    y=alt.Y('sum(Current power (MW)):Q', title='Total Power Use (MW)'),
    #color=alt.Color('Name:N', title='Data Center'),
    order=alt.Order('Name:N'),
    tooltip=['state:N', 'Name:N', 'sum(Current power (MW)):Q']
).properties(
    title='Data Center Energy Use by State',
    width = 800,
    height = 400
)

chart2.show()

```
